chunks.arabic_text: وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ قَالَ:

translations.en: And it is narrated from Ibn Muskan, from Ishaq al-Mada'ini, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الْقَوْمِ يَدْخُلُونَ السَّفِينَةَ يَشْتَرُونَ الطَّعَامَ فَيُسَاوِمُونَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ يَشْتَرِيهِ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ فَيَسْأَلُونَهُ فَيُعْطِيهِمْ مَا يُرِيدُونَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ فَيَكُونُ صَاحِبُ الطَّعَامِ هُوَ الَّذِي يَدْفَعُهُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَ يَقْبِضُ الثَّمَنَ

translations.en: I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a group of people who board a ship and buy food. They bargain over it, then one man from among them purchases it, and the others ask him for some of it, so he gives them what they want of the food, while the owner of the food is the one who hands it over to them and receives the price.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ مَا أَرَاهُمْ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ شَارَكُوهُ»

translations.en: He said: "There is no harm in it. I see them only as having partnered with him."

chunks.arabic_text: فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ صَاحِبَ الطَّعَامِ يَدْعُو الْكَيَّالَ فَيَكِيلُهُ لَنَا وَ لَنَا أُجَرَاءُ فَيَعْتَبِرُونَهُ فَيَزِيدُ وَ يَنْقُصُ

translations.en: So I said: "Indeed, the owner of the food calls the measurer and he measures it for us, and we have laborers who inspect it, and it may increase or decrease."

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْءٌ كَثِيرٌ غَلَطٌ».

translations.en: He said: "There is no harm in it so long as it is not a large amount of error."
translations.ur: انہوں نے فرمایا: "جب تک غلطی کی مقدار زیادہ نہ ہو، اس میں کوئی حرج نہیں۔"
translations.tr: Dedi ki: "Çok büyük bir hata olmadığı sürece bunda bir zarar yoktur."
translations.fa: فرمود: «اشکالی ندارد تا زمانی که اشتباه زیاد نباشد.»
translations.id: Beliau berkata: "Tidak mengapa selama kesalahan itu tidak dalam jumlah yang banyak."
translations.bn: তিনি বললেন: "যতক্ষণ বড় ধরনের ভুল না হয় ততক্ষণ এতে কোনো ক্ষতি নেই।"
translations.es: Él dijo: "No hay daño en ello mientras no sea un error grande."
translations.fr: Il a dit : « Il n’y a pas de mal tant que l’erreur n’est pas importante. »
translations.de: Er sagte: „Es ist kein Schaden darin, solange es kein großer Fehler ist.“
translations.ru: Он сказал: «Нет вреда в этом, пока ошибка не является большой.»
translations.zh: 他说：“只要错误不大，没有害处。”

en.summary: This hadith addresses a commercial arrangement in which one person purchases food and others subsequently take shares from that purchase while the original seller delivers the goods and receives payment. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام permits this arrangement and also allows minor discrepancy in measurement, provided the error is not substantial.
en.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islam for several people to share in a food purchase made by one buyer, with slight measurement differences?

key_terms.الطَّعَامَ: food being bought and distributed in the transaction
key_terms.السَّفِينَةَ: the ship on which the people were traveling and conducting the purchase
key_terms.يُسَاوِمُونَ: they negotiate or bargain over the price
key_terms.شَارَكُوهُ: they became his partners in the purchase
key_terms.الْكَيَّالَ: the measurer who weighs or measures out the goods
key_terms.الثَّمَنَ: the payment or price received for the goods
key_terms.غَلَطٌ: error or discrepancy in the measured amount
